assumptions.tank: 315 L perfectly mixed; 3 kW; 8 C thermostat hysteresis; initial state Manual45
assumptions.loss: 0.3 percent of temperature difference above 20 C per hour
assumptions.tariff: synthetic configured Aurora-like fixed AEST; not current price advice
assumptions.peak_policy: Never schedule heating during peak, for every strategy
assumptions.cloud: fixed 30-minute successful reads; 20-minute refresh heuristic; successful POST + 1-minute readback; counts are modelled, not measured
assumptions.service: same 2.5 kWh useful evening draw; daytime-draw case adds 4 kWh; identical initial conditions per case
assumptions.equal_terminal: hypothetical later off-peak grid replenishment to greatest terminal stored energy in each case; no extra loss/latency; not an executed plan
assumptions.limits: no stratification, native protective cycles, owner intervention, failed commands or outages; physical ON/OFF not verified by this model; target misses are explicit, not compensated by terminal value; no annual savings inference
